title: 有馬記念の後に・世界、遠のいて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Dober runs with all she has, she realizes how stark the difference in strength between her and the senior racers is, and this realization sends her into a depressive episode.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after the Arima Kinen, Mejiro Dober and I watch a feature program on this year's classic racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, they barely bring up Mejiro Dober. Instead, all the commentators do is gush about the achievements of past Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is frustrated by how far away she is from the new Mejiro legacy she dreams of forging, but that doesn't mean she's giving up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Carrying her promise with Mejiro Bright in her heart, Mejiro Dober takes her first steps in making her comeback at the Osaka Hai!
